name: sunseekr
description: Pubs, cafés, restaurants and rooftops in direct sun, hour by hour.

interface.longDescription:
SunSeekr knows where the sun is. Ask for a sunny terrace, a pub garden that keeps the sun until sunset, or a café that gets the afternoon sun on Saturday, and SunSeekr answers with its own sun data: for every venue, the hours it is in direct sun, worked out from the buildings around it.

What you can ask:
- Where is sunny right now, or at a time you choose, near any place
- Which of the places ChatGPT already found will be in the sun (great with restaurant and bar searches)
- Terraces that keep the sun until sunset
- When one venue gets the sun today
- What's trending in a city right now
- Your saved SunSeekr spots, and saving new ones

Answers come as SunSeekr sun cards: each place with its hour-by-hour sun chart, how long the sun lasts, the weather (on a cloudy day it shows where the sun would be if it breaks through) and a link to the venue in SunSeekr. ChatGPT can then show the places on a map and look up reviews, opening hours and bookings.

Covered cities: London, Paris, Berlin, Amsterdam, Hamburg, Munich, Copenhagen, Cologne, Bristol and Manchester. Elsewhere, ChatGPT will tell you SunSeekr doesn't cover that place yet.

Sign in with a SunSeekr account, which you can create while connecting.
defaultPrompt: Find me a sunny pub garden near Farringdon, London right now
Where near Shoreditch can I catch the last of the sun this evening?
Which of my saved SunSeekr spots will be sunny this afternoon?
